Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Valorizamos a colaboração, o diálogo aberto e entregas que compreendam as necessidades das pessoas que usam nossas soluções. Se você é uma pessoa que gosta de construir, testar, aprender e se comprometer com a excelência, a Neon é pra você.

Requisitos

  • Mentalidade Orientada a Resultados: Perfil proativo, criativo e resiliente, habituado a um ambiente dinâmico e a trabalhar com metas desafiadoras de performance.

Adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios em um ambiente dinâmico

Foco em resultados, com habilidade para priorizar o que gera mais impacto

Autonomia e colaboração para trabalhar de forma produtiva no modelo remoto

O que você vai encontrar aqui?

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto de verdade, com encontros de time a cada 3 meses em São Paulo. Também tem crédito para compra de Kit Home Office e parceria para uso de coworkings;

A Neon adota uma política para garantir controle e transparência no tratamento de dados de todas as pessoas, inclusive aquelas interessadas em fazer parte do nosso time. Missão da vaga

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade , manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX , assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.

Responsabilidades (o que você fará no dia a dia)

  • Envios diários ao BCB (via APIX / RSFN, quando aplicável) :
  • Posições de saldo em contas (contas de pagamento, contas de liquidação e correlatas).
  • Fluxos / saldos enviados a participantes responsáveis / liquidantes.
  • Conferência de retornos, logs e reprocessamentos quando necessário.
  • Reconciliação financeira e operacional :
  • Conciliação diária entre core de pagamentos , banco / liquidante, SPI / PIX e razão contábil.
  • Tratamento de pendências (ajustes, divergências, estornos / devoluções) com trilha de auditoria.
  • Apoio à contabilidade em rotinas regulatórias :
  • CCS (Cadastro de Clientes do SFN) : coleta de dados, validação e acompanhamento de envios / retornos.
  • Integrações APIX : suporte funcional às cargas / consultas, evidências dos envios e SLAs.
  • Preparação de dossiês e evidências para auditorias internas / externas e fiscalizações do BCB.
  • Calendário regulatório da IP :
  • Manter o calendário de obrigações sempre atualizado (diárias, mensais, trimestrais, anuais).
  • Sinalizar riscos de prazo, antecipar bloqueios e propor planos de ação.
  • Indicadores e reporting :
  • Consolidar e reportar dashboards de acurácia / pontualidade dos envios , posição de saldos, ageing de reconciliações e status de CCS / APIX.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para Diretoria (Finanças / Compliance / Operações).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em Finanças / Backoffice / Controladoria em fintech, IP, banco, subadquirente ou similar.
  • Vivência com obrigações regulatórias do BCB para IP (ex. : CCS, integrações APIX , posições de saldo, evidências e trilha de auditoria).
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado (proc-x, Tabela Dinâmica, validações).
  • Noções de SQL para consultas simples em bases transacionais / BI.
  • Atenção a detalhes, raciocínio contábil e disciplina de processos.
  • Comunicação clara para interface com Contabilidade, Operações, Risco / PLD-FT e parceiros.

    • Diferenciais (bons de ter)

  • Experiência com SPI / PIX , RSFN, participantes responsáveis / liquidantes.
  • Familiaridade com normas recentes do BCB aplicáveis a IPs (ex. : Resoluções BCB 429 / 2024, 496 / 2025, 506 / 2025, 507 / 2025 , entre outras).
  • Python para automação de rotinas / checagens e BigQuery / PostgreSQL .
  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras (cartão, PIX, split, subcontas) e indicadores operacionais (ex. : devoluções / MED, ageing).

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência .
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.

    • KPIs da função (como mediremos seu sucesso)

  • Pontualidade dos envios obrigatórios (meta : 100% dentro do prazo D+0 / D+1, conforme obrigação).

Overview

Role : Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

You bring a systems mindset, a bias for action, and a commitment to beautiful, scalable design that serves both our customers and our internal teams.

You’ll play a foundational role in defining what design means at Flex — establishing our patterns, raising our bar for craft, and turning bold ideas into products that make running a business simpler and more intuitive. At Flex, we care about clarity, simplicity, and designing for real humans with real constraints. As part of this journey, you’ll help define how design shapes the future of financial tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Design experiences that make life simpler for business owners, turning Flex’s core hypothesis into products people love.

  • Define the design culture at Flex — set the tone, shape the systems, and establish standards that scale.
  • Partner directly with leadership, including the Head of Product and CEO, to translate vision into tangible, high-impact experiences.
  • Work from zero to one: clarify ambiguous problems, define scope, and deliver polished, functional design.
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and product partners to ship fast without compromising quality.
  • Champion simplicity and coherence, ensuring every product surface feels connected, intentional, and delightful.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Multi-faceted. You’re a high-level generalist who can tackle a range of challenges — from zero-to-one concepts to system-level refinements.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You seek clarity through collaboration, not waiting for it to arrive. You build artifacts and frameworks that help define what products and features should become.
  • Driven and resilient. You thrive in fast-paced, high-intensity environments. You see pressure as fuel and believe that great work emerges from deep focus and ownership.
  • Collaborative to your core. You communicate early and often, working as one team with product, engineering, and leadership to move in the same direction.
  • Thoughtful and opinionated. You have taste — and the conviction to advocate for it — while staying open to feedback and iteration.
  • Mission-oriented. You care deeply about helping business owners succeed, and you bring that empathy to every decision you make.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products end-to-end. A sharp eye for craft, detail, and delight — you care about the last 10%. Experience building, using, and evolving design systems that scale across teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — you clarify problems, define strategy, and move teams forward.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills that influence across product, engineering, and leadership.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with ambitious goals and high standards.

Nice to Have:

  • Coding experience, specifically React
  • Motion, animation, or interaction design skills
  • Strength in visual identity or brand expression
  • Familiarity with fintech or complex business systems

The salary range for this role is $65,000 - $90,000 a year.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you

At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success.

Why Join Us

Flex is growing quickly — you’ll help shape the direction of a product and company with real momentum.

We’re well-capitalized with strong backing and a clear long-term vision.

You’ll work with a sharp, driven team that values autonomy, clarity, and quality.

Join ambitious builders who care deeply about winning together — and having fun while doing it.

Annual team on-sites. From Bogota to Mexico City, the entire Flex team gets together once a year to align and build camaraderie.

Job description

A Fundação José Silveira, instituição comprometida com a promoção da saúde e bem-estar na comunidade, busca um analista para integrar a equipe de Planejamento, Custos e Processos . A transparência, ética e respeito mútuo são os pilares que promovem um ambiente de trabalho saudável e inspirador.

A equipe de Planejamento, Custos e Processos é formada por profissionais dedicados e experientes, focados na otimização de recursos e na garantia da sustentabilidade financeira da organização . Trabalhamos de maneira colaborativa, estimulando a troca de conhecimento e ideias para alcançar os melhores resultados. Valorizamos a proatividade, criatividade e a busca constante por aprimoramento. Se você busca uma experiência enriquecedora em um ambiente comprometido com a comunidade, junte-se a nós nesta missão!

Main responsibilities

  • Mapear, analisar e redesenhar processos de média complexidade, visando eficiência e padronização.
  • Aplicar metodologias de melhoria contínua, como PDCA, 5W2H, SIPOC, entre outras.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e propor soluções com base em dados e indicadores.

  • Colaborar em projetos multidisciplinares, garantindo a integração dos processos entre áreas.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico a analistas juniores, orientando boas práticas e metodologias.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação com ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de produção, Tecnologia da informação e afins.
  • Desejável curso de especialização em BPM (Gerenciamento de processos de negócios) e técnicas de BPMN (fluxogramação), Lean Six Sigma.
  • Experiência anterior mínima de 02 ano como analista de processos.
  • Competências comportamentais: Adaptabilidade, Comunicação assertiva, Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, Trabalho em equipe, Visão sistêmica, Curiosidade e aprendizagem contínua.

Additional information

  • Oportunidades de capacitação e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inclusivo.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management: Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization: Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development: Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness: Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics: Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated: Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter, think big
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them, be transparent
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment, be the extraordinary you
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment.

title: Staff Ml Engineer (Conversational Ai)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.

Position Overview

You’ll own Yuna’s core conversational intelligence (i.e., spanning retrieval, memory, safety, evaluation, and post-training). You’ll ship user-visible improvements quickly while raising the bar on empathy, reliability, and guardrails. This is a hands-on staff-level role: equal parts research-to-production and platform thinking.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the end-to-end model lifecycle of Yuna’s conversational AI: problem framing → data curation → modeling/fine-tuning/post-training → evals → rollout → monitoring
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Design agentic flows (tool use, planning, multi-turn memory) and safe retrieval for mental-health use cases
  • Build and own the evaluation flywheel: benchmarks, judge models, rubrics for conversational quality, ability to help, safety
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features
  • Establish LLMOps: datasets, prompts/checkpoints/versioning, observability, drift monitoring, and incident response for model quality

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in ML/AI with 3+ shipping LLM/NLP systems in production
  • Deep skill in Python and modern deep learning stacks (PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow), retrieval/RAG, embeddings, reranking, and long-context summarization
  • Experience building agentic systems (tool calling, decomposition, memory) and rigorous eval harnesses (offline + online)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1

Location and Employment Type

Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real impact on the world, building cutting-edge AI systems that improve lives every day

Outliant is a fully-remote, US-based, digital product development and startup consulting company with a team of diverse creators who help conceive seamless digital products. Our teams emphasize growth, creativity, and the freedom to think outside the box.

This is not a feature factory role. You’ll be driving cross-functional outcomes , owning platform reliability and scalability , and partnering closely with engineering, SEO, and CRO teams to deliver meaningful impact.

Requirements

  • Background in engineering or strong technical fluency (e.g., able to discuss code, debug issues, or evaluate feasibility).
  • Experience managing CMS-based systems (e.g., Webflow or headless CMS) at scale.

Vendor/Pilot Program Evaluation and Monitoring

title: GERENTE DE MARKETING (BRANDING)
description:
Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos, mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, economizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Vaga

Gerente de Marketing (Branding) para planejar e executar nosso projeto de marca, estrategicamente alinhado à visão de negócios da Qive. Você será o embaixador da marca, liderando criativos, mensagens-chave e tom de voz, canais proprietários, design, conteúdo, comunicação, PR, palco de eventos, patrocínios, co-Marketing/co-branded, estudos de mercado e thought leadership. Buscamos um líder que posicione o time de Branding como protagonista e seja a força-motriz de um posicionamento de liderança de mercado da Qive.

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de marca: liderar e gerenciar atributos, ativos e mensagens-chave da marca Qive, supervisionando o posicionamento visual e verbal da marca, garantindo a entrega coesa das mensagens estratégicas em todas as plataformas e canais. Gerenciar times criativos internos e terceirizados – design, vídeo e redação.
  • Presença, saúde e impacto de marca: monitorar e avaliar a presença e saúde da marca Qive. Avaliar engajamento e geração de demanda por meio de redes sociais, eventos do setor e outros canais. Monitorar, otimizar e reportar KPIs e resultados periodicamente, garantindo a melhor alocação dos recursos.
  • Comunicação & PR: liderar e executar estratégias para o mercado brasileiro, gerenciando times internos e agência de PR terceirizada. Apoiar a presença digital de executivos-chave da Qive nas redes sociais e outros canais.
  • Palcos de eventos: planejar, conquistar e executar palcos de eventos que gerem demanda e fortaleçam thought leadership.
  • Patrocínios e co-MKT: avaliar, planejar, negociar e executar ações co-branded que fortaleçam a marca da Qive, gerando thought leadership.
  • Thought leadership e estudos de mercado: planejar e executar a estratégia de posicionamento e thought leadership da Qive, incluindo liderar e executar constantes e profundos estudos de mercado sobre o universo do Contas a Pagar.
  • Liderança e atividades executivas: liderar os times de PR, comunicação, e criativos. Estimular a colaboração com executivos e equipes de Marketing para potencializar o impacto da marca.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Marketing B2B Enterprise, e histórico comprovado na criação de estratégias de marca B2B (você deve ser capaz de apresentar casos, de sucesso ou não).
  • Ampla experiência em gestão de marca, conteúdo, criativos, comunicação e PR.
  • Experiência comprovada no uso de IA LLM para escala de produção de conteúdo em Marketing.
  • Mentalidade de negócios: os resultados do seu trabalho serão medidos pelo sucesso do negócio e influência no pipeline comercial, e presença e saúde da marca.
  • Forte capacidade de colaboração: habilidade para construir relacionamentos em todos os níveis da organização e influenciar stakeholders. Entendimento fundamental do papel da transparência e do trabalho em equipe.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
  • Habilidade de negociação e organização.
  • Criatividade e orientação para soluções. Visão ampla aplicada, sem perder a atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de planejamento estratégico e execução.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade e Privacidade

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive. Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Overview

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager - Payins role at dLocal .

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

This role calls for a product manager with a strong ability to deliver solutions that align with customer needs, regulatory standards, and strategic business goals.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience in financial or payments products and a strong background in product management, specifically in delivering scalable, secure and innovative products for the payments or financial services industry.

What will I be doing?

  • You will work closely with a team of skilled engineers and define strategy and roadmap for the platform, evangelizing to the development teams and broader organization
  • You will execute that vision, ensuring every item on the roadmap provides the desired outcome to our customers and the business
  • You will analyze and use data to make informed decisions
  • You will do whatever it takes to make your product and team successful, no matter how big or small the issue may be
  • You will be working with people from all around the globe
  • You will lead and inspire other team members of the Product team

What skills do I need?

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are a must
  • Spanish is desirable
  • Experience being a technical PM OR Developer background
  • Experience in payments with Payins or Payouts
  • Working in a payments company is a must

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube for more about dLocal!

Overview

HEAD OF GROWTH MARKETING

We are looking for a Highly Motivated & Hard-Working Head of Growth Marketing to join the team. As Head of Growth Marketing, you will craft data-driven forecasts and execute strategies that help clients achieve their goals. You will communicate steps taken and how results compare to projections to foster trust and alignment with clients, supporting long-term growth planning and media acquisition. You are a representative and advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its tools. You are expected to deliver with a high standard, driving progress when you are involved. You thrive on challenges, commit to measurable results, and embrace the mantra: Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me.

We Look For

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if you share the core values of our company and are committed to them in driving business success.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and self-motivated to absorb information quickly and effectively.
  • Openness to give and receive feedback and implement it proactively without constant direction.
  • Resourceful and capable of refining skills autonomously.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment with initiative and continuous improvement.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies pride in personal and professional associations; consistently honest and transparent.
  • Exhibits self-awareness and ownership of outcomes.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it to improve performance.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at a high level when it matters most and enjoys hard challenges.
  • Determined to complete tasks despite obstacles, time constraints, or resource gaps.
  • Adapts to change and aims to exceed requirements with passion and creativity.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

  • Kick-off: commitment to hard work, readiness for a challenging role, rapid feedback incorporation, and timely, quality outputs.
  • Onboarding: align with the Brain Trust, collaborate with pod members, manage tasks with attention to detail, maintain data integrity, execute Prophet system for clients, build Growth Forecasts, and align marketing calendars.
  • Daily execution: deconstruct and actualize projections to meet KPIs; combine data analysis with client feedback for strategic plans; act as an early adopter when pivoting.
  • Responsible for implementing CTC's meta best practices and building campaigns using established structures and processes.
  • Maintain and manage ideologies and processes across accounts; monitor campaigns, adjust budgets and strategy to hit daily targets; run tests to beat best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Maintain within 5% delta to the forecast; daily client alignment with forecast and strategy; maintain high client satisfaction; execute Prophet system within timelines; deliver high-quality work on schedule.

Client Communication

  • Champion clear communication with clients; ensure team clarity on goals and deadlines; send daily performance updates; ensure daily alignment of strategy and forecast; provide weekly updates on strategy calls.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Share learnings and contribute to system improvements; collaborate across teams and contribute to future company content.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English; persuasive communication to diverse stakeholders; ability to craft thoughtful, empathetic client messaging; strong presentation skills.
  • Great Data Analysis skills: strong talent for data analysis; familiarity with data tools including Google Sheets.

Past Experience

Detalhes da vaga

Principais Atividades

  • Garantir a melhoria dos processos de assistência de enfermagem com foco na satisfação do cliente, qualidade dos procedimentos, atuando como referência técnica na sua área de especialidade, interna e externamente à empresa; realizar a análise crítica dos processos, identificar oportunidades e propor mudanças em conformidade com as políticas e normas da empresa e melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Atuar como líder técnico dos técnicos III, II e I, assistentes de enfermagem e auxiliar de enfermagem I e II, fornecendo feedback e aconselhamentos na rotina diária da área de processos de atendimento.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento das equipes de enfermagem por meio do apoio na elaboração de treinamentos e conteúdo de divulgação da área.
  • Contribuir para a eficiência dos processos, reduzindo retrabalho, reclamações de clientes e contaminação de amostras e exames.
  • Organizar e definir a distribuição de atividades para a equipe assistencial subordinada, por meio de escalas mensal, semanal e diária.
  • Oferecer suporte às necessidades dos clientes em situações complexas, garantindo atendimento a casos emergenciais, prestando primeiros socorros e encaminhando para atendimento especializado.
  • Garantir atendimento às demandas de enfermagem das unidades por meio da coleta de materiais e execução de exames em casos especiais (coletas e exames infantis, Coletas assistidas, entre outros).
  • Desenvolver processos de promoção à saúde por meio da condução de treinamentos, apoio na elaboração de materiais e divulgação junto a colaboradores e clientes.
  • Assegurar a excelência do atendimento aos clientes por meio do cumprimento de padrões e normas de qualidade, fornecendo orientações e esclarecendo dúvidas relativas às atividades realizadas.
  • Executar coletas e exames de maior complexidade e específicos de enfermeiros (tais como cateter, panicolau, gasometria, entre outros), seguindo procedimentos estabelecidos e atendendo às demandas da unidade.
  • Atuar como responsável técnico pela unidade, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando a equipe de enfermagem e demais colaboradores, bem como no atendimento emergencial a clientes.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Canonical is hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. The role involves managing a distributed team across regions and coordinating with partners and communities to ensure high-quality kernels across supported releases.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and, with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts; Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Head of Cloud Curriculum
description:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

As part of our mission to make data and cloud fluency accessible to all, you’ll lead a dynamic team of instructors, content creators, and technologists to craft cutting-edge courses and projects that shape the future of cloud education. Cloud technologies are transforming how businesses operate, with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP at the forefront. As our Head of Cloud Curriculum, you’ll be instrumental in driving this transformation, helping learners worldwide build the skills they need to succeed.

In this role, you’ll own the cloud content strategy and roadmap, working hand-in-hand with our expert instructors and the broader Cloud Curriculum team — a talented group of educators, data scientists, and technologists. Your focus will be to continuously grow and enrich our cloud content library with impactful new materials. From courses to practice pools to real-world projects, you’ll serve as a thought partner, reviewer, and passionate advocate for our learners.

With a strong technical foundation in platforms like AWS and Azure, and the ability to influence across functions, you\'ll make data-driven decisions and successfully lead complex, high-impact projects. If you have a genuine passion for cloud education and are excited to shape the next generation of cloud professionals while building the world\'s premier network of cloud instructors, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we look for individuals who embody our core values: data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and an unwavering focus on our learners. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for democratizing access to data and cloud technologies.

Your entrepreneurial mindset and collaborative spirit push you beyond simply meeting targets — you’re motivated to empower learners worldwide to succeed in an increasingly cloud-first world. You\'re a true team player who enjoys working across functions: whether you\'re partnering with internal engineering, product, marketing, sales, and support teams, or rolling up your sleeves to strategize directly with clients, you bring energy and curiosity to every collaboration.

You believe that people, processes, technology, and data are the essential ingredients for digital transformation — and you\'re energized by the opportunity to help learners advance their cloud knowledge and skills. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will focus your time on the following areas:

  • Define the Vision: Set the strategy for our Cloud Curriculum roadmap (AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud engineering, DevOps, and beyond).
  • Lead and Inspire: Manage a talented team of content developers and collaborate with external experts to create best-in-class learning experiences.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor industry trends and emerging cloud technologies to keep our curriculum at the forefront.
  • Drive Impact: Build engaging, practical learning paths that help learners unlock career opportunities and enable enterprise teams to scale cloud adoption.
  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Partner closely with product, marketing, and enterprise teams to ensure our curriculum meets the evolving needs of learners and customers.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of management experience, leading teams to success.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, services, and industry best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS and/or Azure) are a plus but not required.
  • Passion for working collaboratively with subject matter experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with interactive technical education platforms like DataCamp or similar.
  • Ability to synthesize, visualize, and clearly communicate complex ideas, including to non-technical audiences.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable challenging ideas constructively and knowing when to push back or seek compromise to drive the best outcomes for the company.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible!
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we\'re awesome!

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

At DataCamp, we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don\'t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We believe skills can be developed and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Your unique talents and perspectives are what make our team great!

SAMMAR – SERVIÇOS MÉDICOS ESPECIALIZADOS

A Clínica SAMMAR – Serviços Médicos Especializados é uma referência em saúde, oferecendo atendimento de excelência em diversas especialidades médicas. Localizada no Complexo Odonto-Médico Itaigara, no bairro do Itaigara em Salvador, a clínica se destaca nas áreas de Oftalmologia, Nutrição Pediátrica, Genética Médica, Hematologia Pediátrica, Gastroenterologia Pediátrica e Nutrologia.

Na Clínica SAMMAR, os pacientes encontram uma equipe altamente qualificada e dedicada, composta por especialistas renomados que utilizam as mais avançadas técnicas e tecnologias para proporcionar um atendimento personalizado e humanizado. O foco da clínica é garantir a saúde e o bem-estar dos pacientes, oferecendo diagnósticos precisos e tratamentos eficazes em um ambiente acolhedor e seguro.

As especialidades oferecidas incluem:

  • Oftalmologia: consultas de rotina e tratamentos especializados para diversas condições oculares
  • Nutrição Pediátrica e Nutrologia: orientação e acompanhamento para o crescimento e desenvolvimento saudáveis das crianças
  • Genética Médica: aconselhamento genético e testes específicos para identificar e tratar doenças hereditárias
  • Hematologia Pediátrica e Gastroenterologia Pediátrica: cuidados especializados para crianças com condições hematológicas e gastrointestinais

Escolher a Clínica SAMMAR é optar por um atendimento de qualidade, pautado pela ética e pelo compromisso com a saúde dos pacientes. A clínica está preparada para oferecer soluções integradas e eficientes, garantindo a melhor experiência em cuidados médicos especializados.
